_doc: Gate of the image-quality suite (read by test/regress/compare_quality.py; explained in test/regress/quality/README.md). 'better' is the direction of an improvement; a change in the other direction larger than 'tol' FAILS, a change in the good direction larger than 'tol' is reported as IMPROVED. 'min_n': parity is gated only when both runs scored at least this many pixels. golden_diff is absolute: it must stay at or below 'max'. 'info' metrics are reported, never gated.

overrides._doc: per run id (e.g. "logH_out4.mask") or scene name: {"<metric>": {"tol": ...}} to loosen or tighten one metric deliberately

_doc_p0: The runs of the SPEC 12.4 and P2 review scenes are scored in STRICT mode (metrics.js): a metric with nothing to score is null, never a perfect 1. hole_leak: zi_H*, fill pixels deeper than the band inside |w| < e^-pi (a count: any new leaked pixel fails). parity_acc, opacity_min and color_off are gated the same way where a run reports them (this suite's 'cover' runs report coverage only). Every gated metric is gated like the metrics above once the run has a baseline; a gated metric that becomes null fails. A run without a baseline entry is reported as NEW and is not compared, but it FAILS when it did not render (ok false). 'targets' are the absolute thresholds the spec sets (12.4 for the new scenes; 11 P2 for every unbounded scene): compare_quality.py reports them as MET / NOT MET (a run that a rule names without a value for the metric is NOT MET) and fails on NOT MET only with --enforce-targets.

targets._doc: rules: 'runs' is a comma-separated list of run-id globs (fnmatch); every other key is a metric with 'min' and/or 'max'; 'note' is printed with the rule. A metric that a run does not report is skipped.

rules.note: SPEC 11 P2: every unbounded scene, the old ones too (sqrt_slit_out16 left out: its tie rows are allowed)
SPEC 12.4 (a): the z^i hole stays empty
P2 review (SPEC 13.12): saturation points (artanh / arctan of the unit disc zoomed out 6x, 12x) and a deep zoom (s = 3e4)
zeros-and-poles step (2026-10-22): (z^2-1)/z by its zeros and pole, exact through the fold (RAT2)
